page_checks.name: book_page_complete
page_checks.expected: HTTP 200 with the book's details and reviews

notes.calls: Bookinfo's services reach each other by fixed hostnames (details:9080, reviews:9080, ratings:9080), so the calls are listed here instead of discovered from environment variables.
notes.soft_calls: Reviewed in the source (istio 1.24.2 samples/bookinfo). productpage.py front(): details and reviews errors are caught with 3 s timeouts and the page still renders with HTTP 200 ('Sorry, product details are currently unavailable for this book.'). reviews LibertyRestEndpoint.java: a ratings failure becomes 'Ratings service is currently unavailable' (timeout 2.5 s, 10 s for reviews-v2). So every call is tolerated: the app is designed to degrade gracefully, and only the page itself is critical.
notes.integrity: HTTP 200 isn't trusted: after recovery the book page must show its details and reviews again. Bookinfo's traffic (locustfile.py) also counts a page missing details or reviews as a failed request, because that's what a reader sees.
